title: Smart industry innovation grant
description: Support for early-stage industrial innovation, from connected prototypes to sustainable production.
eligibility: Swedish SMEs developing an innovative industrial solution. A project plan and co-financing proposal are required.

title: Blue economy innovation call
description: Explore funding pathways for technologies that improve the resilience and sustainability of our oceans.
eligibility: A collaborative European research or innovation project with a measurable marine impact.

title: Digital innovation accelerator
description: A development programme for responsible digital products and scalable AI solutions.
eligibility: An early-stage digital solution, a Swedish business entity, and a clear validation plan.

title: Marine Innovation Day
description: A meeting point for marine technology, offshore energy, and sustainable ocean innovation.
eligibility: Open to organisations working in marine technology. Registration required.

title: Connected Industry Forum
description: Meet the people shaping the next generation of intelligent manufacturing and connected systems.
eligibility: Open to industry representatives, researchers, and technology providers.

title: From data to applied AI
description: A practical session on transforming sensor and operational data into useful AI applications.
eligibility: Bring a real-world data challenge. No previous AI experience required.

title: Designing for a circular ocean
description: Explore circular design methods for the next generation of sustainable marine products.
eligibility: For marine innovators and sustainability teams. A product concept is helpful.

title: Innovation lunch at the park
description: Fresh perspectives, shared challenges, and new connections across the local innovation community.
eligibility: Open to ecosystem members and invited guests. Registration required.

title: Connected systems testbed
description: Validate connected sensors and automation systems in a real industrial environment with research expertise.
eligibility: A working prototype and a defined testing challenge. Technical scoping is required before admission.

title: Baltic Sea living lab
description: Field-test marine monitoring and clean energy technology in a coastal test environment.
eligibility: A marine-ready prototype and a safety assessment. Test plans are reviewed individually.

title: Digital health pilot programme
description: Connect your digital health product with clinical expertise and a supported pilot environment.
eligibility: A digital health prototype, a privacy impact assessment, and a defined clinical use case.

title: AI Lab Blekinge: model sandbox
description: Laboratory time with GPU workstations and AI coaches to prototype and evaluate a machine-learning model on your own data.
eligibility: A defined AI use case and a sample dataset you are allowed to share. Lab sessions are booked after a short scoping call.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Blue Digital Testbed: IoT security test
description: Testbed that runs your connected device against common attacks and network faults, with a findings report you can act on.
eligibility: A working device or gateway and its firmware version. Testing takes about two weeks.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Immersive demonstration studio
description: Demonstration environment with VR/AR and a large-screen digital-twin setup to show a prototype to customers, investors and partners.
eligibility: A demo-ready prototype, video or digital twin. Half-day or full-day slots.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Karlskrona harbour pilot programme
description: Pilot opportunity with port and ferry operations to validate maritime monitoring and connectivity solutions in daily use.
eligibility: A product ready for a three- to six-month pilot, liability insurance, and a named contact for the pilot period.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Coastal microgrid testbed
description: Testbed for energy storage, renewable generation and smart-grid control in a real coastal microgrid.
eligibility: Hardware or control software with a safety assessment. Grid connection is approved case by case.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Archipelago underwater test site
description: Testbed with moorings, a test pontoon and divers for underwater sensors, drones and acoustic equipment.
eligibility: A marine-ready prototype and a deployment plan. Weather windows decide the final dates.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Smart factory pilot line
description: Pilot opportunity on a running production line to validate automation, machine vision or predictive maintenance with real throughput.
eligibility: A solution that can run alongside production without stopping it, and a plan for measuring the result.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.

title: Home-care living lab
description: Laboratory in real homes and care settings to test remote-monitoring and assistive technology with users and care staff.
eligibility: A prototype that meets basic privacy requirements and an ethics-ready test plan. User recruitment is handled by the lab.
uncertainty: Simulated demo listing: the offer, dates and requirements are illustrative.
